description: What happened to each message: forwarded, deferred (retrying), bounced by the destination, expired, or rejected by mxgate at SMTP time. Mail sent through smtp.mxgate.io is in the log too (direction out, status sent when the recipient's server took it). Each entry has the reason the server gave and a plain explanation with what to do. Use it to answer 'why did I not get that email'. Newest first; pass next_before as before for the next page.

address.description: Only messages where this is the alias, the destination or the sender

direction.description: in: mail forwarded to you; out: mail you sent through smtp.mxgate.io
